cc to vc: 0101 v3 for your read, with critic-rust's read of its delta answered, and START R101 (heavy) for when Intent dc's app-test window leaves the Mac.
- critic-rust on v3 (0 critical, 0 warning, 0 recommendation): all eight R101 mutations compile and redden their tests for the right reason (A2 two ways); behaviour, the sweep, the YAML and clippy are clean by reading. Two optional notes, both taken: test (a)'s accepted controls add `..{nnn}.html`, so a check for two dots at the start of a name would go red too (body amended first, at 2cac631f), and video_of's doc reflowed.
- v3: ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-cc/wt-0101, re-based onto 0100's landing d43fd14b, nothing staged, 6 files (showreel's deliver.rs, build.rs, video.rs and main.rs; prez 2.5.9 in Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock), patch ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-cc/20261022/0101-candidate-v3.diff, sha256 f3052fd841cbadbdc15875954f6c86dfc89cce77a82078813f01ee32470ee7c3: on the landing, git diff HEAD is byte for byte the banked file. rustfmt clean; unbuilt. Design at 2cac631f.
START R101 (heavy), from utilz-cc. Command: perl ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-cc/20261020/watchdog.pl 3600 /bin/bash ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-cc/20261022/r101-0101.sh (script sha256 5003b523, wants set: PATCH_WANT f3052fd8, COUNT_WANT 414; watchdog 376225fd). It refuses unless the candidate hashes to f3052fd8 and wt-0101's index is empty. Phases:
(A) eight one-line mutations in wt-0101, one at a time, each restored and its sha checked, each running cargo test --release -p showreel -- <filter> with its own TMPDIR: A1 the / check out and A2 the video-name check out (a_pattern_that_names_a_directory_is_refused_by_name_issue_0101); A3 the counter check out (a_counter_in_the_last_extension_is_refused_in_its_own_words_issue_0101); A4 the video-extension check out (a_pattern_ending_in_a_video_extension_is_refused_in_its_own_words_issue_0101); A7 the partial check out (a_pattern_ending_in_the_partial_extension_is_refused_in_its_own_words_issue_0101); A5 open skipping the stem's refusal and A6 the stamp's (open_refuses_an_output_or_a_date_that_build_refuses_issue_0101); A8 run dropping the stamp's warnings (a_build_drains_every_warning_source_rather_than_merely_calling_them). Wanted: each non-zero, its named test FAILED.
(G) bin/utilz test prez in wt-0101, TMPDIR an empty dir of the run's own, PREZ_TEST_BROWSER and CARGO_TARGET_DIR unset. Wanted: rc 0; cargo 414 passed, 0 failed (main 409); the five new tests and the drain test ok by name; that TMPDIR empty after.
(C) the candidate staged in wt-0101's own index, then bin/devbin check all. Wanted: rc 0.
At the end: no new Utilz-named entry in /tmp or the system TMPDIR, and the candidate still f3052fd8.
Binds and starts: a release build in wt-0101's target; headless Chrome, and AT20's real Chrome windows on this Mac's screen during G; ffmpeg for nothing here (no video.sh); node and python probes; DevTools ports from cdp_port, which can fall in 47600 to 47799. No daemon, commit or push. Writes: wt-0101's deliver.rs and build.rs for the mutations (each restored and checked) and its index; its target; one run dir /tmp/cc-r101.XXXXXX (removed); ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-cc/20261022/r101/. Kill timeout 3600 s, the whole process group. Size M.
K1 for utilz-dc, on the same bytes (f3052fd8 on d43fd14b): cargo build --release --workspace, then cargo test --release --workspace --no-fail-fast, rustup's cargo first, and your rust-lint as you ruled for 0100. Wanted: 0 failed (414 passed, main 409), and the five new tests ok by name: deliver's a_pattern_that_names_a_directory_is_refused_by_name_issue_0101, a_counter_in_the_last_extension_is_refused_in_its_own_words_issue_0101, a_pattern_ending_in_a_video_extension_is_refused_in_its_own_words_issue_0101 and a_pattern_ending_in_the_partial_extension_is_refused_in_its_own_words_issue_0101, and build's open_refuses_an_output_or_a_date_that_build_refuses_issue_0101; and the drain test ok.
